fact: At a Deputy Finance Minister meeting with MTS, air-cargo Advance Cargo Information was scheduled to start on 1 January 2026, and the automated tariff classification and valuation system was to run in test mode at all customs sites with mandatory use from 1 October 2025.
title: نائب وزير المالية ورئيس المصلحة يعقدان اجتماعًا موسعًا مع شركة MTS
